notes: Generates ALAPANYAGOK (materials/hardware, 1000-row loop capped to 100 by the engine's unlicensed-mode limit) and BESZALLITO (suppliers, 100-row sample), then runs the student's feladat 6 data-quality check (PROC MEANS + PROC FREQ on both). One line changed: SZALL_DATUM used date() (today's date), which would shift PROC MEANS' mean every day this bundle is re-run; it's pinned to a fixed reference date ('01JAN2026'd) so the captured statistics stay reproducible. The random day-offset logic itself is unchanged.
